title: D3ARC: Time-Critical Distributed Disaster Detection for Asynchronous Cooperative Multi-Robot Systems
abstract: arXiv:2609.07350v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Climate change is increasing the severity and unpredictability of natural disasters. In time-critical crises such as wildfires, traditional monitoring practices remain limited by coverage, cost, and personnel risk, paving the way for autonomous and adaptive monitoring solutions. Within this context, this paper introduces D3ARC, an asynchronous distributed hierarchical framework for time-aware and reliable wildfire detection. D3ARC integrates multiple robotic agents that cooperate under uncertainty through distributed perception, shared situational awareness and coordinated actions. A remote controller asynchronously decides upon each robot's motion, while each robotic agent senses the environment and decides where and how to execute the wildfire detection. translated_title: D3ARC：面向异步协作多机器人系统的时间关键型分布式灾难检测
translated_abstract: 气候变化正在加剧自然灾害的严重性和不可预测性。在野火等时间紧迫的危机中，传统监测方法仍然受到覆盖范围、成本和人员风险的限制，这为自主和自适应监测解决方案铺平了道路。在此背景下，本文提出了D3ARC，一个用于时间感知且可靠的野火检测的异步分布式分层框架。D3ARC集成了多个机器人智能体，它们通过分布式感知、共享态势感知和协调行动，在不确定性条件下进行协作。远程控制器异步决定每个机器人的运动，而每个机器人智能体感知环境并决定在哪里以及如何执行野火检测。所有机器人操作都需要时间，随着时间的推移，野火会持续蔓延，从而减少早期干预的机会。因此，所有智能体共享一个共同的目标……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出了D3ARC，一个面向异步协作多机器人系统的分布式分层框架，通过分布式感知、共享态势感知和协调行动，实现时间感知且可靠的野火检测。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes D3ARC, an asynchronous distributed hierarchical framework for multi-robot systems that achieves time-aware and reliable wildfire detection through distributed perception, shared situational awareness, and coordinated actions.
